ar.title: تورتة بلاك فورست

steps.n2: يضرب البياض في المضرب جيدا جدا بعد إضافة 3 ملاعق صغيرة ماء.
steps.n3: يخفق الصفار جيدا في إناء ثم يضاف إلى البياض المضروب في الخلاط مع إضافة السكر ويضرب الخليط جيدا حتى ذوبان السكر.
steps.n4: يخلط الدقيق بالكاكاو وبالبيكنج باودر ويضاف تدريجيا إلى الخليط بالتبادل مع اللبن حتى ينتهي المقدار.
steps.n5: تدهن الصينية بالسمن ويرش خفيفا بالدقيق ثم توضع الكيكة عليها وتدخل فرن متوسط الحرارة حتى النضج.
steps.n7: تقطع الكيكة نصفين وتحشى بجزء من كريمة الشيكولاته ويمكن رشه بالبندق المفري.
steps.n8: يوضع النصف الثاني للكيكة ويغطى بباقي الكريمة، ثم يرش السطح بالشيكولاتة المقطعة وتغطى الجوانب بالبندق المفري.
steps.n9: ممكن تجميله أيضا بإضافة وردات من الكريم شانتيه مع الكريز المسكر.

en.title: Black Forest Chocolate Torte

steps.n1: Separate the egg whites from the yolks.
steps.n2: Beat the egg whites thoroughly in a mixer after adding 3 teaspoons of water.
steps.n3: Whisk the yolks well in a bowl, then add them to the beaten whites in the mixer along with the sugar, beating well until the sugar dissolves.
steps.n4: Mix the flour, cocoa, and baking powder, then gradually add them to the mixture alternating with the milk until all ingredients are incorporated.
steps.n5: Grease a baking pan with butter and lightly dust with flour, then pour the batter into the pan and bake in a medium-heat oven until done.
steps.n6: Once baked, leave the cake to cool.
steps.n7: Cut the cake in half and fill with a portion of the chocolate cream, sprinkling with crushed hazelnuts if desired.
steps.n8: Place the second half of the cake on top and cover with the remaining cream, then sprinkle the surface with chopped chocolate and coat the sides with crushed hazelnuts.
steps.n9: You can also garnish by adding swirls of whipped cream with candied cherries.

legacySteps: Separate the egg whites from the yolks.
Beat the egg whites thoroughly in a mixer after adding 3 teaspoons of water.
Whisk the yolks well in a bowl, then add them to the beaten whites in the mixer along with the sugar, beating well until the sugar dissolves.
Mix the flour, cocoa, and baking powder, then gradually add them to the mixture alternating with the milk until all ingredients are incorporated.
Grease a baking pan with butter and lightly dust with flour, then pour the batter into the pan and bake in a medium-heat oven until done.
Once baked, leave the cake to cool.
Cut the cake in half and fill with a portion of the chocolate cream, sprinkling with crushed hazelnuts if desired.
Place the second half of the cake on top and cover with the remaining cream, then sprinkle the surface with chopped chocolate and coat the sides with crushed hazelnuts.
You can also garnish by adding swirls of whipped cream with candied cherries.
